nom: Dermasuri Deep Exfoliating Face Scrub Mitt

segments.sensitive: Several reviewers with self-described very or extremely sensitive skin report the mitt exfoliates without causing irritation, redness or harshness, calling it gentle enough for daily use.

concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers specifically note the absence of irritation or redness after use, describing the mitt as gentle despite its exfoliating strength.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report reduced acne breakouts and clearer skin with regular use; none report worsened breakouts, though a few give only moderate 3-4 star ratings citing unremarkable results rather than negative skin effects.
